lines.t: Yeah… Houston bass, kingdom business…
From trauma to triumph in YahuShua…
Used to numb all the pain, kept the anger in my chest
Devil had my mind locked, pride tight on my neck
Then The Word cut deep, broke the yoke, broke the shield
Now His voice in my heart, that’s the place where I heal
He play on the replay, childhood in my head
Flashback loop, same scene, what they did, what they said
“Never cry, never need, never trust, just fight”
So I built me a throne outta trauma and spite
Inner vows: “I’m alone, I’ma always be cold”
Every coping a cage, every wall took hold
But The Light came in, started readin’ my file
Pulled lie after lie out the hurt and denial
Now I name what I feel, bring the thoughts to the Throne
Renounce every script that was never my own
Trade shame for confession, defense for the truth
Let His love rewrite every program in my youth
Used to numb all the pain, kept the anger in my chest
Devil had my mind locked, pride tight on my neck
Then The Word cut deep, broke the yoke, broke the shield
Now His voice in my heart, that’s the place where I heal
He sell self‑determined like a crown for a king
“Be your own salvation, you don’t owe Him a thing”
But a self‑made man still crack under weight
When the guilt and the grief hit the door too late
So I fall on my face, put my pride in the dirt
Let the tears run raw, let Him name every hurt
He expose every scheme that was hid in my brain
Turn triggers to altars, trauma into terrain
I agree with His Word when it clashes with me
Let obedience cut where my flesh wanna flee
Speak life to my soul when the night press in
“I belong to YahuShua, that’s a war I win”
Used to numb all the pain, kept the anger in my chest
Devil had my mind locked, pride tight on my neck
Then The Word cut deep, broke the yoke, broke the shield
Now His voice in my heart, that’s the place where I heal
Breathe in peace, breathe out war
Every breath say “YH,” every breath “UWAh”
Heart sync up to the beat of His scars
Mind stay fixed on the Bright Morning Star
Now I hack every thought when it step in my lane
If it don’t match Him, I don’t let that remain
I forgive on sight so my soul stay clear
Bless those that cursed me so my heart don’t sear
Got brothers on the line when my head feel loud
Bring dark to the light so it can’t wear a shroud
Meditate on His Word till the lies get thin
Armor on, love strong – that’s the way we win
Used to numb all the pain, kept the anger in my chest
Devil had my mind locked, pride tight on my neck
Then The Word cut deep, broke the yoke, broke the shield
Now His voice in my heart, that’s the place where I heal
If you stuck in the loop, in the script you believe
Let His name hit your soul, watch the devil just leave
